name: opencode-memory-monorepo
description: opencode 本地持久记忆插件：三层记忆（长期知识/情景摘要/会话工作记忆），纯本地 SQLite + jieba 中文检索

scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/opencode typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/opencode build
scripts.format: biome format --write packages/core/src packages/core/tests packages/opencode/src packages/opencode/tests examples package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages/core/src packages/core/tests packages/opencode/src packages/opencode/tests examples package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
